title: Minouche Shafik Leaves Post as Chief Economic Advisor to UK PM
title_cn: 米努什·沙菲克 (Minouche Shafik) 辞去英国首相首席经济顾问职务
summary: Minouche Shafik, the former Bank of England deputy governor and International Monetary Fund director, has left her post as chief economic advisor to Britain’s prime minister, according to people familiar with the matter.

title: Democratic Socialist Advance Hits Wall in Wisconsin Primary
title_cn: 民主社会主义在威斯康星州初选中遭遇挫折
summary: Moderate Democrat David Crowley defeated Democratic Socialist Francesca Hong in Wisconsin’s primary for governor, an upset in a race that had become a test of the party’s ideological direction.

title: Trump Media Pitches $1.2 Million Truth API to Wall Street Traders
title_cn: 特朗普媒体向华尔街交易员推销 120 万美元的 Truth API
summary: Donald Trump’s social media company has been leaning on Wall Street’s fear of missing out in its pitch for a controversial new subscription to faster feeds from the president’s Truth Social account.

title: Bolivia Aims to Limit Expropriations With Investment Bill
title_cn: 玻利维亚旨在通过投资法案限制征用
summary: Bolivia’s government is proposing limits on the executive branch’s ability to enact expropriations and nationalizations of private investments in a bid to attract capital to its struggling economy.

title: Key Russian Port Halts Grain Exports After Ukrainian Attack
title_cn: 乌克兰袭击后俄罗斯主要港口停止谷物出口
summary: Three of Russia’s largest grain terminals in the Black Sea port of Novorossiysk have halted operations after being damaged in a massive overnight drone attack by Ukraine.
